armyRules.name: Faceless Hydra
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. The Legion is never quite where the enemy thinks it is. A unit with this rule has Shrouded (6+) against Shooting Attacks from more than 18" away, but suffers -1 Cool while no other friendly Alpha Legion unit is within 12".
armyRules.condition: while no other friendly Alpha Legion unit is within 12"

armyRules.name: Sabotage Cell
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, at the start of the enemy turn, a unit with this rule may choose an enemy Vehicle within 18"; that Vehicle gains the Stunned Status. The unit cannot Rush in its own next turn.

armyRules.name: Many Masks
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Enemy Precision (X) attacks cannot single out a Character with this rule unless it is the only model left in its unit. Trust is a weakness: the Character suffers -1 Leadership.

wargear.name: Mirror-cloak
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A shimmering mantle that throws back a dozen false outlines of its wearer. The bearer gains Shrouded (6+), or one step better if they already have it.

wargear.name: Reagent injector
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A wrist-mounted cocktail of stimms and counter-toxins, tuned for agents who expect to be poisoned in return. The bearer gains Feel No Pain (6+).

wargear.name: Sleeper-cell beacon
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A tiny pulse-caster that lets scattered cells act on a single plan without a word on the vox. Every model in the unit gains +1 Cool and +1 Intelligence.

wargear.name: Cell pennant
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A scrap of cloth in the cell's private colours, worn by whoever the cell trusts. Gives the unit Cell Swap.

wargear.name: Venom-bladder harness
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Glands and reservoirs that coat every blade the bearer carries. Gives the bearer Venom Laced.

wargear.name: Ghost-signal scrambler
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A vox-mimic that fills the enemy's channels with orders that never came. Gives the bearer Signal Ghost.

wargear.name: Dead-drop cache
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A buried crate of the right ammunition, left exactly where the plan said. Gives the unit Cache Opened.

wargear.name: Chameleonic hull-skin
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A pigment-shifting coat that is hard to find and harder to hold in a sight. Gives the vehicle Shifting Hull.

wargear.name: Mirror-smoke dischargers
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Smoke charged with reflective grit so the hull seems to be in three places at once. Gives the vehicle Mirror Smoke.

rules.name: Cell Network
rules.text: Legacy house rule (A Hundred Cells, One Hand). A unit with this rule adds +1 to its Cool for Cool Checks while at least one other friendly unit with Cell Network is within 12".

rules.name: Sleeper Strike
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Sleeper Awakens). In its controlling player's first turn, a unit with this rule adds +2 to its Charge rolls. The unit must be deployed on the table using Infiltrate, and may not start in Reserve.

rules.name: Many Heads
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Hydra's Gambit). A unit with this rule gains Outflank. After both armies have deployed, the Alpha Legion player may swap the positions of two units with this rule (both units must be on the table, in the same deployment zone).

rules.name: Purge Resolve
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Dreadwing Purge-Host). A unit with this rule automatically passes Cool Checks while it is within 6" of at least one other friendly unit with this rule.

rules.name: Cell Swap
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, at the end of its Movement phase, a unit with this rule that is not in combat may swap places with a friendly Alpha Legion Infantry unit of equal or smaller size within 6" that is also not in combat.

rules.name: Venom Laced
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Melee weapons carried by the bearer gain Poisoned (5+), or the Poisoned (X) value they already have improves by 1.

rules.name: Signal Ghost
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Enemy units cannot use Reactions against the bearer's unit while it is more than 12" away from them.

rules.name: Cache Opened
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, in the Shooting phase, a unit with this rule's ranged attacks gain Armourbane and +1 Ballistic Skill.

rules.name: Shifting Hull
rules.text: Legacy house rule. A vehicle with this rule has Shrouded (6+) against Shooting Attacks from more than 24" away, or Shrouded (5+) if it did not move in its last Movement phase.

rules.name: Mirror Smoke
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, at the start of the enemy Shooting phase, the vehicle imposes -1 on all Hit Tests made against it until the start of its next turn. The vehicle cannot make Shooting Attacks in its next turn.

Any Recon Legionary may exchange their Astartes shotgun for a Coil-spined needle carbine
Any Scout may exchange their bolter for a Coil-spined needle carbine

The unit may carry a Sleeper-cell beacon
The unit may carry a Cell pennant
The Sergeant may wear a Venom-bladder harness
Agent's kit: may take up to two items
The Sergeant may arrange a Dead-drop cache
May be fitted with Chameleonic hull-skin
May be fitted with Mirror-smoke dischargers
The Sergeant may take a Mirage-needle rifle

The Saboteur may carry a Cell-charge satchel

modifiers.text: Trained to kill the head, not the body: +1 BS, -1 CL.
Every legionary a cell leader: +1 IN, -1 LD.
Shadow-killers with no home to return to: +1 BS, -1 CL.
Hardened by purge after purge: +1 LD, -1 M.

rites.name: A Hundred Cells, One Hand
rites.flavor: No cell knows the plan. Every cell knows its part.
benefits: Headhunter Kill Teams, Seeker Squads and Reconnaissance Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Those units gain Cell Network: +1 Cool for Cool Checks while another friendly unit with Cell Network is within 12".
limitations: At least two Headhunter Kill Teams are required.
No Armour, Heavy Transport or Lord of War units.

require.note: Field at least two Headhunter Kill Teams.

modifiers.text: A Hundred Cells, One Hand: Cell Network, Line (1).

rites.name: The Sleeper Awakens
rites.flavor: They were standing beside you before the war began.
benefits: Tactical, Veteran Tactical and Inductii Squads gain Infiltrate (9).
Those units gain Sleeper Strike: in the controlling player's first turn they add +2 to their Charge rolls.
limitations: No Transport, Heavy Transport or Fast Attack units.
Units with Sleeper Strike must be deployed on the table with Infiltrate; they may not start in Reserve.

modifiers.text: The Sleeper Awakens: Sleeper Strike, Infiltrate (9).

rites.name: The Hydra's Gambit
rites.flavor: Alpharius is present, and three other Alpharii are also present.
benefits: Exodus, Headhunter Kill Teams and Mor Deythan Squads gain Hatred (Command) and Many Heads: Outflank, and after both sides have deployed the Alpha Legion player may swap the positions of two units with Many Heads.
limitations: Alpharius must be in the army.
At most one Tactical Squad and no Veteran Tactical Squads.

modifiers.text: The Hydra's Gambit: Many Heads, Hatred (Command), Outflank.

rites.name: Dreadwing Purge-Host
rites.flavor: When the whispers fail, the Dreadwing is sent to finish the argument.
benefits: Dreadwing Interemptor and Lernaean Terminator Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1) and Purge Resolve: they automatically pass Cool Checks while within 6" of another friendly unit with Purge Resolve.
Interemptors gain Rending (6+) in close combat and shooting.
limitations: At least two Dreadwing Interemptor Squads are required.
No Recon or Fast Attack units.

require.note: Field at least two Interemptor Squads.
